2026.11.12.1 is a tests-only release: git diff d9c91be shows module.ts changed only by the version and a new upgrades list with one identity entry, so this verdict stands from the review of 2026.10.29.1. A ko or go failure throws before any write with argv, directory and stderr. Refused before ko runs: a main-package set that is empty, bare naming with several commands, a tag with bad characters, an ldflags entry with a comma, a tarball with several platforms or several commands (ko rewrites the file per run), a tarball or layout together with the daemon (ko never writes them), and a layout path ko cannot name (lowercase only). A printed reference not among the recorded ones throws; a recorded reference without a digest throws. An image-refs file ko never opened (a resolve that built nothing) reads as empty, not as a failure.

Reviewed the new module_test.ts against d9c91be. The fake go and ko are gone; describe, build and resolve each run through createModelTestContext with a stub exec at __setExec that answers only the binary-and-argument prefixes its test lists, writes ko's --image-refs file where the test needs it, and is restored in a finally. Each method has a success test asserting the resource records (spec, name, digest, pushed, count, builtHere, unpinned, allPinned) and the written files (buildRecord, manifests), and a failure test asserting the error and that neither a record nor a file was written. The pure parts keep their tests, including the daemon publisher's digest-as-tag reference. No credential is taken, so none to plant. deno task test: 11 passed, 1 ignored (opt-in e2e). README's new test paragraph matches the file.
